child.text:
[{"insert":"Yoga Pushup + Poliquin Lateral Raise
 
This is a super set for the shoulders and chest. Start with the yoga pushup, dropping into a pushup then pushing the hips back and up into a downward dog before returning, which turns a pushup into a shoulder movement through a full range. Move into the Poliquin lateral raise, leaning away from an upright and raising the outside arm so the side delt works through a longer arc. Take both close to failure with thirty seconds between them.
"}]
